item.title: Emiliano Ariel Videla Rodríguez
item.dc:creator: Teaching Co-ordinator
item.description:
Background

Emiliano is a teaching co-ordinator at the Edinburgh Medical School. He did an integrated master degree in biological sciences at the Universidad Nacional de Córdoba, Argentina. He did his PhDs at the Universidad Nacional de Córdoba (Argentina) and the Universitat de Lleida (Spain). During his academic career, he speciliased himself in statistical programming and computational biology, with focus on Bayesian Networks as graphical expert systems to facilitate decision making.

Experience

  • Programming languages: R, Python, Shell

  • Data wrangling and pre-processing: integration of databases, feature engineering, data discretization.

  • Data analysis: Bayesian and Social Networks, General and Generalized (Mixed) Models, Machine Learning modelling.

  • Website development

  • Project and partnership management

Courses for UG and PGT

  • Data Science for Health and Social Care

  • Introduction to Statistics

  • Research Design and Reproducible Skills

  • Research and Evidence Based Medicine

  • Data Analysis with R

Continuing Professional Development

  • Edinburgh Teaching Award - Associate Fellow (in progress)

Publications

  • Videla Rodriguez E.A., Bouba I., V.A. Smith, van der Brand H., Rodenburg T.B., and B. Viser. 2024. A two-step Bayesian network approach to identify key SNPs associated to multiple phenotypic traits in four purebread laying hen lines.. PLoS ONE. 19:e0297533.

  • Videla Rodriguez E.A., Mitchell J.B.O., and V.A. Smith. 2024. Robust identification of interactions between heat-stress responsive genes in the chicken brain using Bayesian networks and augmented expression data.. Scientific Reports. 14:9019.

  • Videla Rodriguez E.A., Mitchell J.B.O, and V.A. Smith. 2022. A Bayesian network structure learning approach to identify genes associated with stress in spleens of chickens. Scientific Reports. 12:7482.

  • Videla Rodriguez E.A., Pértille F., Guerrero-Bosagna C., Mitchell J.B.O., Jensen P., and V.A. Smith. 2022. Practical Application of a Bayesian network approach to poultry epigenetics and stress.. BMC Bioinformatics. 23:261

Outside work

  • Emiliano plays volleyball for Jets Volleybal Club, competing at the National Scottish League and some regional leagues.

  • He usually carries a book with him so he is grateful for any recommendations.

Contact details

📧 Emiliano.Videla.Rodriguez@ed.ac.uk

🔗 LinkedIn

item.title: Laila Dabab Nahas
item.description:
Background

Laila has a bachelor and MSc in biotechnology, and a PhD and postdoctoral in bioinformatics.

Current job

Teaching assistant in Edinburgh Medical School

Experience

  • High performance computers (Eddie)

  • Programming languages: Shell, R, SQL, NLP, Python

  • Websites development

  • GitHub

  • Analysis such as scRNA, RNA and HiC.

Courses for UG and PGT

  • Data Sciences for Health and Social Care

  • Foundational and Applied Research Design courses

  • Introduction to Databases and information systems

  • Natural Language Processing (NLP) in Health and Social Care

  • Foundations of software development in Health and Social Care

CPD

  • AFHEA

  • PGCap in progress ..

Cool ideas

Escape room for teaching in Foundational Research Design

Research and supervision

  • Co-supervising a GWAS project for PG with Dr. Kristin Nicodemus

  • Co-supervising a SLICC project with Dr. Nadege Atkins

  • A mentor in Education Beyond Borders programme at The University of Edinburgh

Publications

Laila Dabab Nahas - Google Scholar

Participating in two chapters in a coming book

Outside work

  • A very proud mother

  • Manges here own small business, Ibn Battuta Arabic online centre for teaching Arabic for children and adults

  • Volunteers in Home-Start East Lothian

  • Started to learned playing piano recently!

  • Loves reading books (such as “Atomic Habits” by James Clark and “That little sound in your head” by Mo Gawdat) and socializing

  • Loves to learn new things
